caption:
Skydance is restructuring senior roles in India. Amazon cut roughly 1,000 India jobs on 8 October. Oracle has opened a fresh round. All of it inside the pre-Diwali window.

Notice what these have in common: the cuts are landing on senior layers first. The defence most of us were sold — get senior enough and you're safe — is failing in public.

A reorg does not sit with your appraisal history. It works off a thin map of who is visible, who is attached to decisions, who gets named in the room when the room is deciding. The least visible person goes. Not the least competent.

In command, you learn this early. Authority is not conferred by title. It is held through bearing, through tone, through knowing exactly when not to speak. Those are trainable.

Competence is your floor. It was never your cover.

topic.title: Layoffs are hitting senior layers first, before Diwali
topic.angle: The defensive logic of 'get senior enough and you're safe' is visibly failing — reorgs remove the least visible person, not the least competent, which is the most emotionally live fear in this audience right now.
topic.why_now: Skydance's senior-level India restructuring (~9 Oct), Amazon's ~1,000 India cuts on 8 Oct and Oracle's fresh round all land inside the pre-Diwali window, a tension that evaporates after the festival.
